//include: The four core modules the scripts import through the ts-resolve hook, listed one by one rather than as src/core/**. This project has no chrome types by design, and these four are the pure ones: palette, marks, url and schema (which imports only palette and url). Widening it to the whole directory pulls in storage, settings and permissions and fails on `chrome`.
